scripts.e2e:cloud: node scripts/wasm/ensure.mjs && cargo build -q -p kentos-api && node scripts/e2e/cloud.mjs
scripts.rust:wasm: cargo build -p kentos-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/kentos_wasm.wasm
scripts.rust:wasm:formats: cargo build -p kentos-formats-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/io/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/kentos_formats_wasm.wasm
scripts.test:rust: pnpm rust:test && pnpm wasm && vitest run src/wasm src/io
scripts.db:setup: cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- db-setup && cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- migrate && cargo run -q -p kentos-api --bin kentosd -- dev-seed
